entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Alex. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your recent order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like that was delivered about 26 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band?
It's just hard to use. The interface is not what I thought it would be.
I see. Is it a specific technical fault, like it's not turning on, or more of a preference issue with how the menus are set up?
Preference, I guess. It's just very confusing. I read the user manual and I still can't get it to do what I want easily. Frankly, I expected more.
I understand completely. It's important that the device feels intuitive for you. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for your order.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and since the item was delivered within the last 90 days, you are definitely eligible for a full refund. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.

Of course. I have just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
Whatever. As long as it's handled.
It is. Was there anything else I could help you with today, Alex?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
